result.note: Tests the trade relationship facts and negotiation timeline, plus the Republic Day 2026 chief guests. Skips the signing itself, which was only expected.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about India–European Union trade relations, as of January 2026:
items: Negotiations on an EU-India free trade agreement first began in 2007 and restarted in June 2022 after collapsing.
The EU is India's largest trading partner, with goods trade of about USD 130 billion in 2024.
India ranks fifth among the EU's trading partners.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: India ranks ninth for the EU, not fifth, while the EU is India's largest trading partner. The proposed agreement would link a market of nearly 2 billion people covering roughly a quarter of global GDP.
questions.source: The EU is India’s largest trading partner (USD 130 billion in goods in 2024).

questions.prompt: Who were the chief guests at India's Republic Day parade on 26 January 2026?
options: The Presidents of the European Commission and the European Council
The President of France and the Chancellor of Germany
The President of the European Parliament and the EU foreign policy chief
The UN Secretary-General and the WTO Director-General
questions.explain: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and European Council President Antonio Costa were the chief guests. Their visit was timed ahead of the 27 January EU-India summit, where the free trade agreement was expected to be signed.
questions.source: She and European Council President Antonio Costa will also attend India’s Republic Day (January 26) parade as chief guests.
